name: Firecrawl
description: Web search and page scraping via the Firecrawl v2 API (https://firecrawl.dev), exposed as two declarative HTTP tools. Provides the swappable `web.search` and `web.extract` layers, so selecting it in the layer picker re-points the stable `web__search` / `web__extract` tools at Firecrawl without changing what agents call. Requires a BYOK Firecrawl API key.
tagline: Search and scrape the web for agents

config.description: Web search via Firecrawl. Returns ranked web results with titles, URLs, and descriptions. Requires RYU_FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.
Scrape a single web page with Firecrawl and return its main content as markdown. Requires RYU_FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.

url.description: The URL of the page to scrape.

config.description: Start a Firecrawl crawl job and return its id. Asynchronous: poll firecrawl__crawl_status with the returned id. Requires RYU_FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.

url.description: The start URL to crawl from.

maxDiscoveryDepth.description: Link-discovery hops to follow from the start URL.

config.description: Read the status and accumulated pages of a Firecrawl crawl job started by firecrawl__crawl_start. Requires RYU_FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.

id.description: The crawl job id returned by firecrawl__crawl_start.

fields.label: Firecrawl API key
fields.description: Create a key at https://www.firecrawl.dev/app/api-keys and paste it here. Stored encrypted on this node and never shown again — re-paste to change it. Without a key the Firecrawl tools stay installed but return nothing, so `web.search` / `web.extract` fall back to whichever other provider you select.
